content: Handling references when deriving objects from blueprints • Blueprints may reference standardized objects. These references also exist in the derived objects (1), (2). • Blueprints may reference other blueprints (3). These references need to be re- placed in order to meet [constr_2546]. Therefore a reference from a derived object to a blueprint is not allowed. • Blueprints may contain references to arbitrary objects (4). According to [TPS_STDT_00041] it is allowed that these objects even do not exist.
